openArt.title: Three Peaches on a Plate / 盘中三桃
openArt.credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington
openArt.changes: Resized and encoded as WebP. Actual fill template fruit.js and cover fruit.webp quantized from the artwork into 10 colors and 22 connected regions. Original aspect ratio retained. No AI generation or runtime network.

selectedArt.title: 草莓柑橘甜品店
selectedArt.source: User-attached artwork explicitly selected for the gallery on 2026-11-11
selectedArt.original: 参考资料/用户确认素材_20261111/草莓柑橘甜品店/用户指定原画.png
selectedArt.changes: Prepared offline with the existing engine, 64 requested colors / 59 retained colors, 510 connected regions. Narrow regions were merged into adjacent similar colors. The cover and in-app reference show the actual completed palette image.
selectedArt.runtime: Bundled static template; no runtime image generation or network requests.
